display_long_description:
UFence is a mixed-reality fencing game designed for players of all ages and experience levels, using a primarily passthrough environment to safely recreate the accuracy, timing, and technique of real sword fencing in your own space.

Train and compete through a variety of fencing challenges, lessons, and AI-driven matches that focus on authentic fencing fundamentals such as distance, timing, cadence, blade control, and footwork. Realistic sword physics and responsive feedback help players develop precision and consistency with every action.

The experience includes multiple fencing games, each offering three progressive difficulty levels to test and improve your skills. For more advanced training, a dedicated fencing dummy allows experienced fencers to practice freely, refine techniques, and create their own training routines.

An in-game AI coach provides structured lessons that introduce core fencing concepts step by step, making UFence suitable for beginners while still offering depth for experienced fencers. Players can train casually for fun or use the experience regularly to support real-world fencing practice.

All game modes are fully playable in a wheelchair, and the passthrough design allows players to remain aware of their real-world surroundings at all times. Only a small clear area is required, making it easy to enjoy fencing safely at home.
